correctness.rationale: The proof reconstructs all definitions and quantifiers. The family-specific lemma \(a\le\Delta\) follows because the \(\Delta+1\) smallest degree sum exceeds the edge count, and Gupta's equality criterion then forces \(M\le\Delta/(\Delta-1)\). The remaining \(\Delta\ge3\) and \(\Delta=2\) cases are exhaustive. Direct invariant calculations verify all four surviving graphs. A standalone enumerator independently checks all 2693 complete-multipartite types through order 20; this finite check is explicitly not used as the infinite proof.

value.rationale: Sharpness structure is a natural follow-up to a newly resolved conjectured inequality. Complete multipartite graphs form a standard infinite family containing complete graphs, stars, bicliques, and Turán graphs. The result replaces the source's invariant-based equality condition by a complete isomorphism classification and isolates a reusable structural estimate \(a\le\Delta\); it is not an arbitrary finite slice or a parameter substitution.
